summary: Layer 1B expansion for the underfollowed lane. Reference anchors remain Vertiv, Eaton, GE Vernova and Quanta Services, but the discovery list is shifted toward smaller or less obvious public suppliers and service providers in switchgear, electrical contracting, custom engineered power infrastructure, data-center field services, and mission-critical site/electrical infrastructure. The strongest early evidence is backlog/order language tied to data centers and utility/electrical demand, but later layers must verify customer concentration, project margins, capacity additions, lead times, and whether backlog converts into profitable revenue rather than one-time construction-cycle pull-forward.
